reason: Exported DTO classes are named *Dto throughout (CatalogDownloadDto, UserDto/CreateUserDto in user.dto.ts, RequestRuleDto/SelectedReleaseDto in requests.dto.ts) and no lint naming rule exists in .eslintrc.cjs. reason: Handlers get UserAccessControl/AdminAccessControl via UseGuards on the class (catalog, downloads, server-log) or method (metadata, users); there is no APP_GUARD. label: WRONG
reason: ApiTags sits only on controller classes (catalog, downloads, events, auth), never on methods, so the wording misleads (clear false). The only outlier is the TMDB proxy marked @ApiExcludeEndpoint, which is left out of the Swagger docs, so a tag would do nothing there: 0 of 1 counted. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since a new documented controller without ApiTags would be worth flagging.
